psc.description: LoRA wall time from explicit log timer. Generation includes all retry rounds. Readout sums explicitly logged per-clip Cellpose time. Chunk elapsed time comes from log start/end timestamps (not file mtimes); residual includes readout, relabeling, model loading, export and other overhead. These are job-seconds, not measured accelerator utilization or parallel elapsed time.

fluo.description: LoRA wall time from explicit log timer. Generation includes all retry rounds. Readout sums explicitly logged per-clip Cellpose time. Chunk elapsed time comes from log start/end timestamps (not file mtimes); residual includes readout, relabeling, model loading, export and other overhead. These are job-seconds, not measured accelerator utilization or parallel elapsed time.

hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, 96 GB, four devices; documented 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12
execution: GPU LoRA/video generation, concurrent generation chunks; CPU painting; readout durations from explicit per-clip log timers.
limitations: Server configuration is historically documented; individual per-job GPU model and utilization are not logged. Do not divide summed component times by CPU painting time to infer a controlled acceleration ratio.
